correctness.rationale: Verified support h(u)=Σ_v|u_v|+Σ_{vw}|u_v−u_w|, and derived exposed-free-generator rank: genuine facets have normals ±1_S for nonempty connected induced S; offset = |S|+|∂S|. Consequently largest origin-centered ball is min_S (|S|+|∂S|)/√|S| and center locus consists of |Σ_Sc|+r√|S|≤|S|+|∂S| for all connected S. Cubical edge induction via partition along coordinate and binary entropy proves |∂S|≥|S|(d−log2|S|). Let t=log2|S|∈[0,d]; lower bound g_d(t)=2^{t/2}(d+1−t) has derivative of sign (ln2)(d+1−t)/2−1, so strict global minima only endpoints (t0 singleton vs td full). Values d+1 and sqrt(2^d) cross exactly between d5 and d6. Equality only full set for d≤5, and singletons for d≥6, establishing tangent facet counts; strict finite slack for noncontacts gives center locus dimension 2^d−1 or 0. Independent degree bound |x_v|≤d+1, equality signs propagate along connected bipartite cube to ±χ, giving only ±(d+1)χ outside contacts, R=(d+1)sqrt(2^d) and one diametral pair. Exhaustive all subsets of cubes d≤4 independently reproduced strict equality classification; no finite test claimed for d≥5.
